entities.summary: Logan Tyler Webb is an American professional baseball pitcher for the San Francisco Giants of Major League Baseball (MLB). He was selected by the Giants in the fourth round of the 2014 MLB draft, and made his MLB debut in 2019. Webb was named an All-Star in 2024 and 2025.
